Header: Curvularia lunata, Cercospora oryzae, Helminthosporium oryzae, Fusarium semitectum, Trichoconis padwickii, Sarocladium oryzae โรคเมล็ดด่าง

Prevention: Mix seeds with anti-fungus such as carbendazim or mancozeb rate 3 g/1 kg of grain before sowing
If direct sowing, use seed rate of 15-20 kg/rai
Avoid mono-rice variety (plant two varieties in the same field)
Monitoring: Regular field survey every two weeks especially booting stage (if 5% disease incidence/area need to control)
Monitor the weather conditions to be prepared for disease outbreak.
Conditions such as temperature and windy conditions will be favourable for disease development and epidemic
Restrictions: Apply when 5% of disease incidence in the rice field polyoxin
FRAC G1 + WHO II Carbendazim + mancozeb
